scripts.build: npm run build -w sdk && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w chat && npm run build -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w sdk && tsc --noEmit -p chat/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p admin/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w sdk && npm run test:conversation -w chat
scripts.dev:chat: npm run build -w sdk && npm run dev -w chat
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build -w sdk && npm run dev -w admin
